annotations.title: Check if a Dutch company is bankrupt (paid)

description: Use when you need to know if a Dutch company is bankrupt or in suspension of payments: live check in the Centraal Insolventieregister (Rechtspraak) with active and ended cases, court, case number, dates, administrator and claims deadline. Legal entities only. Input: KvK number or company name. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed
